title: Insanely-Talented Player
altTitles: チート級才能のプレイヤー
description: It has been six years since the game that will decide the fate of the world began. Kang Yoosung, the Hero King and strongest player, has never surrendered his position as the world's top ranker. As a new season begins, mysterious powers and increasingly dangerous challenges appear before him. With his extraordinary talent, overwhelming experience, and a unique ability tied to provocation, Kang Yoosung begins his survival journey in a game where failure means death.
author: OMinute / Horakan / Chena
